subject: Retirement phasing: staffing asks + draft customer notice for review
summary: Product requests a phased retirement plan for the legacy /v1/generate model, asks for cross-functional staffing commitments for cutover windows and reviews a draft customer notice and exemption intake template.
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Retirement phasing: staffing asks + draft customer notice for review

Team —

Quick background: Product is planning a phased retirement of the legacy /v1/generate endpoint (model family: rf-small) to simplify our model catalog and reduce maintenance burden. Plan target: start phased cutovers in Q1 2027 with soft cutover windows for a set of flagging customers. Before we lock dates, I need two things from each org: 

1) Staffing commitments for each proposed cutover window (primary + on-call backup). We expect 4 windows over a 6-week runway.
2) Feedback on the attached draft customer notice (short notice + migration guidance) and the exemption intake template we plan to use.

Proposed initial window options (pick preferred):
- Week A: 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-16 (low-traffic)
- Week B: 2027-01-24 to 2027-01-30 (mid-traffic)
- Week C: 2027-02-07 to 2027-02-13 (high-traffic)

Immediate asks by EOD Tues (2026-11-23): 1) confirm primary + backup names for each window; 2) redlines to the sample notice or flag any legal/compliance blockers.

Attached: sample_customer_notice_v1.docx (draft), exemption_request_template.xlsx

Thanks — happy to run a 30-min sync if needed.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. PM, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retirement phasing: staffing asks + draft customer notice for review

Thanks — moving to confirm staffing. A couple quick notes after skimming the notice: 

- Legal: can we avoid wording that implies data retention changes? Keep the notice focused on API endpoint availability and recommended migration paths. I can send suggested wording; filing a short redline doc.
- Compliance: if any customer asks for longer retention of the v1 behavior, they'll need an exemption and an associated risk acceptance. The exemption template looks fine but add a required field for data residency impact (yes/no + details).

Staffing (primary / backup):
- Cutover windows Week A/B/C: Irene Choi (primary), Marissa Cole (backup)
- Week D (if needed): Ben Carter (primary), Neha Kapoor (backup)

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@simplify.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retirement phasing: staffing asks + draft customer notice for review

Adding context from CS/sales: we have three active customers who will need pre-cutover migration help (Acme Inc, Simplify.ai, and Tradewise). I'm looping Sara from Acme to confirm their constraints (Sara: thanks for being on standby).

CS asks: 
- Please provide a short migration checklist in the notice (code snippet + recommended replacement model, e.g., /v2/generate with rf-medium).
- Two-week advance runbook for any customer scheduled in a window (dry-run support).

Redlines: I recommend the customer notice include a very short FAQ and an explicit contact alias (support+migration@redwood.ai). Otherwise looks good.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retirement phasing: staffing asks + draft customer notice for review

Thanks for pulling this together. A few ops/infra points before we lock windows: 

- Capacity: we'll need to reserve a small pool of dedicated instances to handle migration-related traffic for customers we support during their dry-runs. I estimate 3 medium instances per active customer day. I'll confirm exact numbers after a short cal with infra.
- Rollback plan: include explicit fallback timing in the notice (we recommend a 90-minute rollback window per cutover). Ops will require a scheduled rollback owner for each window.
- Monitoring: please add the runbook section referencing the health checks we need (latency p99, error rate thresholds).

I'll send a follow-up with capacity numbers by Mon EOD.

Ben Carter
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

On Sat, 21 Nov 2026 at 11:46, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Adding context from CS/sales: we have three active customers who will need pre-cutover migration help (Acme Inc, Simplify.ai, and Tradewise). ...

---

Attachment log: sample_customer_notice_v1.docx (draft) — 1 page: short notice + migration checklist; exemption_request_template.xlsx — columns: customer, account_team, justification, requested_end_date, data_residency_impact

---

Final consolidated action (from Mateo):
- Mateo will incorporate legal wording changes (Irene) and add the two-week runbook snippet (Marissa).
- Ben will confirm capacity numbers and provide rollback owner names by Mon EOD.
- Neha to own publishing schedule and HubSpot ticket template (HS-12345).

Thanks everyone — I'll circulate updated draft and a short 30-minute sync invite for Mon to finalize dates.

— Mateo
